blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: NAWE (Neural-Assisted Watermark Extraction) combines an explicit signal-processing watermarking construction with a pretrained neural host predictor. A periodic, perceptually masked watermark carrier provides synchronization, Polar coding supplies redundancy, and denoising followed by subtraction extracts the embedded watermark. The denoiser remains frozen, without watermark-specific training. A one-factor-at-a-time study compares Wiener, BM3D, DRUNet, and GS-DRUNet host estimators. Comparisons with TrustMark, SSL Watermarking, PixelSeal, and WAM show NAWE’s lowest geometric and photometric class BER and strong message recovery, while filtering and noise remain limitations consistent with the non-adaptive selection of the watermark extractor. The comparison retains the systems’ different payloads and coding. The code will be available at GitHub on paper acceptance.
blocks.zh: NAWE(神经-辅助水印取出)结合了一种明确的信号处理水印建筑与一个预受训练的神经宿主预测器. 一个周期性的,能感知到被遮住的水印载体提供同步,极地编码补给冗余,再去诺后再取出嵌入的水印. 德诺瓦人仍然被冻结,没有经过水印专用训练. 一项一次性研究比较了Wiener、BM3D、DRUNet和GS-DRUNet主机估计器。 与TrustMark,SSL水印,PixelSeal,和WAM的比较显示NAWE的几何和光度分类BER和强烈的信息回收率最低,而过滤和噪声仍然是与水印提取器的非适应性选择一致的限制. 比较保留了系统的不同有效载荷和编码。 该代码将在GitHub的接受纸上提供.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Invisible image watermarking must preserve visual quality while recovering a message after image processing and geometric distortion. Filtering and compression corrupt watermark evidence; cropping, resizing, and rotation also disturb carrier alignment. Robustness therefore requires synchronization, encoding, and suitable watermark extraction for efficient host-interference suppression.
blocks.zh: 隐形图像水印必须在图像处理和几何扭曲后恢复信息的同时,保持视觉质量. 过滤并压缩腐败的水印证据;裁剪,再大小和旋转也扰乱了载体对齐. 因此,强健需要同步、编码和取出适当的水印来有效抑制宿主干扰。

blocks.en: Classical signal-processing designs include spread-spectrum modulation [ 7 ] , perceptually masked transform-domain embedding [ 4 ] , and stochastic content-adaptive allocation and host estimation [ 23 ] . Quantization index modulation [ 6 ] , known-host data hiding [ 17 ] , and improved spread spectrum [ 14 ] address host interference at embedding or detection. Geometric robustness has been pursued through transform invariants [ 15 ] , registration templates [ 16 ] , and repeated spatial patterns with autocorrelation-based acquisition [ 12 ] . Subsequent periodic and self-reference constructions combine this synchronization principle with multibit coding and adaptive embedding [ 22 , 21 , 9 ] .
blocks.zh: 古典信号处理设计包括散相谱调制 [7],能感知到被遮住的变形域嵌入 [4],并有分解的内容适应分配和主机估计 [23]. 量子化指数调制 [6],已知主机数据隐藏 [17],并改进了分布谱 [14] 在嵌入或检测时地址主机干扰. 几何稳健性一直通过变换变异性[15],注册模板[16],以及以自相通取为主的重复空间模式来追求. [12]. 随后的周期和自引用构建将这种同步原理与多位编码和适应性嵌入[22,21,9]结合起来.

blocks.en: Learned systems extend this tradition through robust representations and distortion-aware embedder/extractor training [ 10 , 5 , 18 , 19 ] . NAWE instead uses a neural model for a specific receiver task: predicting the host so that subtraction extracts the watermark, thus providing the host interference cancellation. A coded, repeated spatial watermark carries out an encrypted message and supplies synchronization, and registered repetitions support soft decoding. The denoiser is pretrained and frozen; the watermarking system requires no task-specific network training.
blocks.zh: 学到的系统通过强有力的表述和扭曲意识嵌入/取出训练来扩展这一传统[10、5、18、19]。 NAWE转而对特定的接收器任务使用神经模型:预测主机,使减取出水印,从而提供主机干扰取消. 一个被编码,重复的空间水印执行加密消息并供给同步,被登记的重复支持软解码. 德诺瓦泽被预先训练并被冷冻;水上标记系统不需要任务特定的网络训练.

blocks.en: Our contribution integrates explicit synchronization with replaceable neural host suppression, compares conventional and neural predictors, and evaluates bit and word error rates, and attack-family behavior.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献将明确的同步与可替换的神经宿主抑制结合起来,比较常规和神经预测器,并评价比特和词错误率,以及攻击-家族行为.

blocks.en: Figure 1: NAWE signal path. Blue blocks perform analytical processing, green blocks carry image or message evidence, and orange denotes the frozen neural host predictor. The host determines the perceptual mask; the independent message and keyed synchronization bits determine the carrier. The receiver shares the key, nonce, layout, and decoder settings.
blocks.zh: 图1:NAWE信号路径. 蓝色块进行分析处理,绿色块携带图像或消息证据,橙色表示被冻结的神经主机预测器. 主机决定了知觉口罩;独立消息和按键同步比特决定了载体. 接收器共享密钥,非ce,布局和解码器设置.

blocks.en: 2 Relation to learned watermarking
blocks.zh: 2 与已学到的水标记的关系

blocks.en: SSL Watermarking [ 10 ] freezes a self-supervised trained network and optimizes each image’s pixels by adversarial embedding: gradient-based updates make feature projections onto keyed directions match the signs specified by the message under a family of defined distortions. Extraction reads those signs without the host. The configurable message length L msg L_{\rm msg} counts direct bits without an outer channel code.
blocks.zh: SSL (英语). 水印 [10] 冻结一个自我监督的训练有素的网络,并通过对抗性嵌入来优化每个图像的像素:基于梯度的更新在按键方向上进行特征预测,在定义扭曲的家族下匹配消息指定的标志. 提取器没有主机读取这些标志. 可配置消息长度 Lmsg L_{\rm msg} 计算没有外通道代码的直接位.

blocks.en: TrustMark [ 5 ] trains a residual embedder and a message extractor with image distortions; both operate feed-forward at deployment. The Q/BCH-5 interface uses 100 carrier bits: L msg = 61 L_{\rm msg}=61 information bits, 35 BCH parity bits, and L schema = 4 L_{\rm schema}=4 schema/reserved bits [ 1 ] . Channel decoding follows neural carrier extraction.
blocks.zh: TrustMark [5] 训练一个有图像扭曲的残余嵌入器和信件提取器;在部署时两者都运行向后传输. Q/BCH-5接口使用100个载体位: L msg = 61 L_{\rm msg = 61个信息位, 35 BCH平分位, L schema = 4 L_{\rm schema = 4 schema / 保留位 [1]. 通道解码跟随神经载体提取.

blocks.en: WAM [ 18 ] trains an embedder and an extractor that jointly localizes marked pixels and predicts a message of length L msg = 32 L_{\rm msg}=32 bits at each location. Spatial aggregation recovers distinct messages from marked regions. Training includes localized embedding, splicing, and geometric/photometric augmentations.
blocks.zh: WAM [18] 训练出一个嵌入器和一个取出器,这些取出器将标记的像素联合本地化,并预测每个位置的长度L msg = 32 L_{\rm msg}=32位. 空间汇总可恢复来自有标记区域的不同信息。 培训包括局部嵌入、分型和几何/相机增强。

blocks.en: PixelSeal [ 19 ] trains a feed-forward embedder/extractor with message length L msg = 256 L_{\rm msg}=256 bits, distortion augmentation, and high-resolution adaptation. An adversarial discriminator supplies the imperceptibility objective instead of fixed perceptual losses, alongside the message-recovery objective. The adversarial optimization occurs during training.
blocks.zh: PixelSeal [19] 列车采用feed-forward 嵌入器/取出器,电文长度为 L msg = 256 L_{\rm msg}=256比特,失真增强,并高分辨率适应. 对抗性歧视者除了信息回收目标之外,还提供不可接受性目标,而不是固定的认知损失。 对抗优化发生在训练期间.

blocks.en: NAWE embeds L msg L_{\rm msg} bits on the native image grid without learnable models and uses a frozen neural denoiser only at the extraction.
blocks.zh: NAWE在原生图像网格上嵌入了L msg L_{\rm msg}没有可学习的模型,只在取出时使用被冻结的神经分泌器.

blocks.en: 4 Evaluation and results

blocks.en: 4.1 Comparison protocol and error rates
blocks.zh: 4.1 比较协议和出错率

blocks.en: We compare native implementations of competing watermarking methods on identical images and attacks at matched embedding PSNR, retaining their payloads and available error correction. These are complete-system comparisons: equal PSNR does not equalize information rate, coding gain, or perceptual visibility. Images are COCO 2017 [ 13 ] resized to 512 2 512^{2} : 100 sources for the robustness benchmark and 100 for one-factor-at-a-time (OFAT) study. Each source draws an independent, domain-separated key and nonce, so key, nonce, and message never repeat.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了相同图像上相互竞争的水标记方法的本国执行情况,以及匹配嵌入式PSNR的攻击,保留了它们的有效载荷并纠正了现有的错误。 这些是全系统比较:等同的PSNR不等于信息率,编码增益,或知觉能见度. 图片为COCO 2017 [13] 调整为512 2 512^{2}: 稳健性基准的100个来源和一次性一要素研究的100个来源。 每个源都绘制出一个独立,域相分离的密钥和非密钥,因此密钥,非密钥和消息从不重复.

blocks.en: Figure 4 plots WER against BER to evaluate the relation between zero-bit and multi-bit performance of NAWE and its competitors. Changing NAWE’s frame length L L shifts its operating points along nearly linear log-log trend as expected when more coded symbols share a fixed distortion budget, without changing the construction or retraining a model. Across 34, 40, and 48 dB, NAWE has lower WER than every payload-matched baseline and competitive BER. At PSNR ⁡ ( 𝐱 , 𝐲 ) < 40 \rm{PSNR}(\mathbf{x},\mathbf{y})<40 db NAWE starts to outperform other baselines in both WER and BER at competitive frame length L L . The most pronounced difference can be observed at PSNR ⁡ ( 𝐱 , 𝐲 ) = 34 \rm{PSNR}(\mathbf{x},\mathbf{y})=34 db, where the competitors are saturated and cannot improve beyond theirs operational boundaries.
blocks.zh: 图4将WER与BER对比来评价NAWE及其竞争对手的零位和多位性能之间的关系. 改变 NAWE 的框架长度 LL 沿近线性日志趋势改变操作点, 当更多编码符号共享固定的扭曲预算时, 而不改变构造或再培训一个模型时, 则如预期的那样。 在34、40和48分贝中,NAWE的WER比每个有效载荷匹配基线和竞争性BER低。 在 PSNR (x, y) < 40\rm{PSNR} (\ mathbf{x},\mathbf{y}) < 40 db NAWE 开始在竞争性框架长度L L. 在PSNR(x,y)=34\rm{PSNR}(\mathbf{x},\mathbf{y})=34 db中可以观察到最明显的差异,竞争者在其中饱和了,无法超越其业务边界改进.

blocks.en: 4.4 Attack-wise behavior and limits
blocks.zh: 4.4 (中文(简体) ). 攻击行为和限制

blocks.en: Figure 5 compares the BER of NAWE and its competitive baselines using the benchmark composition in Figure 2 .
blocks.zh: 图5 利用图2中的基准构成,比较NAWE的BER及其竞争性基线。

blocks.en: Geometry: NAWE has the lowest class average, explained by the explicit synchronization mechanism. Flip and translation lie at the plotting floor, and rotation, shear, and resizing have low BER. SSL is stronger on some families, notably perspective: a general projective warp exceeds the acquisition model, which in a way can be tuned for perspective transforms as well.
blocks.zh: 几何:NAWE拥有最低的类平均值,由明显的同步机制来解释. 翻转和翻译在图案楼层, 旋转,剪接,再大小 低BER。 对一些家庭来说,SSL更强大,特别是视角:一般的投影曲率超过了获取模式,从某种意义上来说,它也可以被调取为视角转换.

blocks.en: Photometric and color: NAWE attains the lowest class summary and stays at the floor throughout this group, with ties on individual operations. Grayscale is particularly challenging for WAM. Altogether the learned baselines demonstrate inconcistency under somewhat trivial and not greatly destructive distortions.
blocks.zh: 光度和颜色:NAWE获得最低的分级汇总,并在整个这一组中停留在地上,与个人操作有联系. 灰度对WAM来说尤其具有挑战性. 所了解的基线总体上表明,在某种微不足道的、而不是破坏性极大的扭曲之下,不一致。

blocks.en: Compression and quantization: NAWE remains competitive, especially for chroma JPEG, chroma subsampling, and palette quantization. Standard JPEG, posterization, and WebP produce more errors, and the other systems can achieve lower BER.
blocks.zh: 压缩和分解:NAWE仍然具有竞争力,特别是在铬JPEG,铬分采样和调色板分解方面. 标准JPEG,海报化,和WebP产生更多的错误,而其他系统可以实现更低的BER.

blocks.en: Filtering, restoration, and noise: NAWE underperforms the competing methods in this class, particularly TrustMark and WAM. Its off-the-shelf denoiser was pretrained for additive white Gaussian noise. Highly destructive attacks that primarily target high frequencies, like denoise and blurs, are excellent watermark suppressors. Nevertheless, severe blur removes commercially useful detail and resulting attacked image has comparatively low SSIM and PSNR. This training-task mismatch limits the current design; training or adapting the host predictor for extraction under these distortions is a future research direction.
blocks.zh: 过滤,还原,和噪音:NAWE在本类中表现不佳的相竞方法,特别是TrustMark和WAM. 它的外壳被预先训练 添加剂白高斯噪音。 以高频率为主要目标的高度破坏性攻击,如出海龟和模糊等,都是出色的水印抑制剂. 尽管如此,严重的模糊清除出商业上有用的细节,由此而来被攻击的图像的SSIM和PSNR相对较低. 这种训练任务不匹配限制了当前的设计;在这些扭曲下培训或调整主机预测器以取出是一个未来的研究方向.

blocks.en: Compound: The compound arms chain several operations to emulate real distribution pipelines, such as messaging and social re-encoding, display capture, and print. NAWE’s behavior on them tracks its per-class results: it stays robust on chains dominated by geometric and photometric steps, but degrades where a filtering or noise stage is present, inheriting the limitation above.
blocks.zh: 化合物 : 复合武器连锁公司采取了若干行动,以模拟真正的分销管道,例如通讯和社会再编码、显示捕获和打印。 NAWE的行为跟踪着它每类的结果:它在由几何和光度级所主导的链上保持坚固,但在有过滤或噪声级的地方则退化,继承了上面的限制。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: NAWE couples an explicit signal-processing construction and a periodic, perceptually masked carrier with autocorrelation-based synchronization and Polar coding – to a frozen neural denoiser used only for host suppression at extraction. This design keeps the receiver blind and free of watermark-specific training while a neural predictor still removes host interference. Across a broad multi-family benchmark NAWE is competitive overall and leads the geometric and photometric classes, and it attains the most reliable whole-word recovery among the compared systems, with a bit/word trade-off that stays predictable by design. Its weaknesses concentrate where the pretrained denoiser is mismatched to the attack, i.e., – strong filtering, restoration, and noise, – rather than in the synchronization or coding stages.
blocks.zh: NAWE 将一个清晰的信号处理架构和一个带有自相机同步和极地编码的周期性、能感知到的掩蔽载体配为只用于在取出时压制宿主的冷冻神经器。 这种设计使得接收器保持了盲目并不受水印特有训练,而神经预测器仍然可以去除宿主干扰. 在整个广泛的多家庭基准中,NAWE总体上是竞争性的,并领导了几何和光度分类,它实现了比较系统中最可靠的整词恢复,并且有一个比特/字的取舍,通过设计可以预测。 它的弱点集中在预先训练出与攻击不匹配的地方,即——强过滤、还原和噪音,而不是同步或编码阶段。

blocks.en: Because the design is synchronization-based, modular, and not learned end to end, each stage can be improved in isolation without retraining the others, so the same construction can be pushed further toward any given attack, transmission channel, or payload regime. We see three directions. First, replacing or fine-tuning the host predictor for extraction under filtering, blur, and noise directly targets the main limitation while leaving the rest of the pipeline untouched. Second, extending the acquisition model from affine to general projective warps would close the remaining geometric gap. Third, since the carrier expands by plain repetition, its scale, code rate, and synchronization budget can be retuned per channel for a specific compression, display, or distribution channel trading capacity for robustness on demand.
blocks.zh: 由于设计是同步的,模块化的,并且没有学习到的结束,所以每个阶段都可以孤立地改进而不用再培训其他阶段,所以同样的构造可以被进一步推向任何特定的攻击,传输通道,或有效载荷系统. 我们看到三个方向。 第一,更换或微调主机预测器,以在过滤下取出,模糊,噪音直接瞄准主限制,而使其余管线未受影响. 第二,将购置模型从同位素推广到一般投影曲面,将缩小所剩的几何差距。 第三,由于载体通过简单重复来扩张,其规模,代码率,同步预算可以被每个信道重新调整,用于特定的压缩,显示,或分配信道交易能力,以求得稳健.
